summary: The netconf plugin is chosen from ansible_network_os and normally shouldn't be overridden. Most need no config. An ncclient device handler name can be set, otherwise default is used.
questions: Do I need to configure the netconf plugin manually?
How do I set the ncclient device handler?
What ncclient handler is used if none is set?

answer_card.title: Using netconf plugins
answer_card.answer_md: The plugin comes from `ansible_network_os`, so there's normally no need to override it. Most need no configuration. You can set an ncclient device handler name in the plugin, otherwise `default` is used. Each plugin documents its own options.
